metadata.match_title: Antigua &a; Barbuda Falcons vs Guyana Amazon Warriors
metadata.toss: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons won the toss and opted to bat
metadata.status_note: Antigua &a; Barbuda Falcons won by 9 wickets

ball_by_ball.commentary_text: IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! Springer finishes things off! A full toss outside the off stump, angled across. Shamar plays the pick up shot. Swings across the line and mistimes the hit. High in the air from the bottom of the bat. Deep square making no mistake on the fence.

IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! Springer finishes things off! A full toss outside the off stump, angled across. Shamar plays the pick up shot. Swings across the line and mistimes the hit. High in the air from the bottom of the bat. Deep square making no mistake on the fence.
On a length and wide of off, swing and a miss.
Full and at the off stump. 126.8 kph. Opens the bat face and nudges it to deep point for a single.
WIDE!!! On a length but pushed too wide outside off, left alone for a wide.
SIX RUNS!! Gets a full toss and puts it away into the stands!! Full toss outside the off stump. Romario muscles it away over deep mid wicket for half-a-dozen runs. An 86-metre hit.
Full and outside off. Digs it out in the leg side from the cue end of his blade.
Over the wicket. Full toss on the middle stump. Swipes across to deep backward square.
82.6 kph. On a length and leg stump, spinning past the inside edge, beats the keeper on the way to the fine leg boundary for four byes.
Short on the leg stump. Punched to deep midwicket for a run.
Full and outside off. Sweeps but misses.
85.7 kph. Full and outside off. Swept to deep midwicket for a single.
81.9 kph. Full and outside off. Defends to extra cover.
Over the wicket. Full and turning away from the fourth stump. Play and a miss on the outside edge.
FOUR RUNS! 86.2 kph. Full and outside the off stump. Sweeps hard and finds the midwicket boundary.
Good length googly on the leg stump. Hits the back pad but impact outside leg.
Full and wide outside off, swing and a miss.
On a length and off. Cuts off the backfoot to Moqim at backward point for a quick single.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and googly outside off, play and a miss.
On a length turning in from the leg stump. Play and a miss through to the keeper.
Full and turning in from outside off. Sweeps but misses, ball goes through the keeper's legs in the fine leg region. Bye picked up.
Good length outside off. Pushed to backward point.
On a length and turning away from outside off. Play and a miss on the outer edge.
FOUR RUNS! 91 kph. Full and close to the off stump. Sweeps it in front of square, over midwicket for four.
Over the wicket. Good length turning in from outside off. Defends off the backfoot.
Full length googly on the leg stump. Goes for the slog sweep and misses.
Full and just outside off. Sweeps to the left of deep backward square for a couple of runs.
Full and outside off. Driven to cover.
Around the wicket. Full on the middle stump. Nudged in the midwicket region for a single.

BOWLED HIM! 4 wickets for Shadab Khan as well! A back of the hand googly pitched full and outside the off stump. Tahir on the front foot looks to go across and plays the wrong line. Shadab hits the perfect line, the ball spins back in and rattles the top of the off stump!

BOWLED HIM! 4 wickets for Shadab Khan as well! A back of the hand googly pitched full and outside the off stump. Tahir on the front foot looks to go across and plays the wrong line. Shadab hits the perfect line, the ball spins back in and rattles the top of the off stump!
Over the wicket. 84.7 kph. Short and pitched outside off. Tahir on the backfoot is hit on the glove.

Appeal for LBW and the finger goes up. Hope sends it upstairs!!! Good length on middle and leg. 90.9 kph. Hope hangs back and shuffles across his off stump, looking to work it away on the leg side. Gets beaten on the inside edge and wears it on the pads. Loud and confident LBW shout and the finger goes up. Fair delivery on the front foot. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat. Three reds on ball tracking, pitching in line, impact in line and wickets hitting. Hope departs and Warriors are 49 for 8.

Appeal for LBW and the finger goes up. Hope sends it upstairs!!! Good length on middle and leg. 90.9 kph. Hope hangs back and shuffles across his off stump, looking to work it away on the leg side. Gets beaten on the inside edge and wears it on the pads. Loud and confident LBW shout and the finger goes up. Fair delivery on the front foot. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat. Three reds on ball tracking, pitching in line, impact in line and wickets hitting. Hope departs and Warriors are 49 for 8.
Full and outside off. Tahir slaps it to long off for a single.

WICKET!!! Just put a mirror image of the previous dismissal!!! Both left-handers in action this time — the batter and bowler. Moqim bowls a wrong'un. Gets it to pitch outside the off stump. Spins back into the batter. Pierre looks to drive through covers, leaving a massive gap between his bat and pad. The ball sneaks through it and cannons into the stumps.

WICKET!!! Just put a mirror image of the previous dismissal!!! Both left-handers in action this time — the batter and bowler. Moqim bowls a wrong'un. Gets it to pitch outside the off stump. Spins back into the batter. Pierre looks to drive through covers, leaving a massive gap between his bat and pad. The ball sneaks through it and cannons into the stumps.
Good length outside off. 88.1 kph. Hope cuts it to deep point for a single.
Full toss on off stump. Pushes it to long off for a single.
Over the wicket. Full on the off stump. Gets forward and drives it to the left of long off for a single.

WICKET!! Hat-trick for Shadab Khan. He becomes the third player to take three in three in CPL!!! Googly, full and outside the off stump. Sampson leaves a massive gap between his bat and pad as he looks to push at it on the front foot. Goes through that massive gap and cannons into the off pole. Shadab goes on a celebratory run and the Guyana fans at Kensington Oval are shell-shocked!!!

WICKET!! Hat-trick for Shadab Khan. He becomes the third player to take three in three in CPL!!! Googly, full and outside the off stump. Sampson leaves a massive gap between his bat and pad as he looks to push at it on the front foot. Goes through that massive gap and cannons into the off pole. Shadab goes on a celebratory run and the Guyana fans at Kensington Oval are shell-shocked!!!

Appeal for LBW and the finger goes up!!!! Mehidy has a chat with his partner and sends it upstairs. Googly, full and outside off. Spinning in sharply. Miraz is late on the push and gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball strikes him below the knee roll on the front pad. Miraz signals the 'T' after a chat with Hope. Fair delivery on the front foot. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat. Pitching outside off, impact is in line and wickets are umpire's call. Warriors keep the review but lose two wickets in two balls. A golden duck for Mehidy Hasan Miraz.

Appeal for LBW and the finger goes up!!!! Mehidy has a chat with his partner and sends it upstairs. Googly, full and outside off. Spinning in sharply. Miraz is late on the push and gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball strikes him below the knee roll on the front pad. Miraz signals the 'T' after a chat with Hope. Fair delivery on the front foot. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat. Pitching outside off, impact is in line and wickets are umpire's call. Warriors keep the review but lose two wickets in two balls. A golden duck for Mehidy Hasan Miraz.

WICKET!!! Hetmyer throws it away once more!!! Full and tossed up on leg stump, googly once more. Hetmyer clears his front leg and looks to launch it over long off but the bat turns in his hands and it goes higher than longer. Hassan Nawaz settles under it at long off and takes a simple catch. Hetmyer shakes his head as he makes his way back to the hut.

WICKET!!! Hetmyer throws it away once more!!! Full and tossed up on leg stump, googly once more. Hetmyer clears his front leg and looks to launch it over long off but the bat turns in his hands and it goes higher than longer. Hassan Nawaz settles under it at long off and takes a simple catch. Hetmyer shakes his head as he makes his way back to the hut.
Googly, full and down the leg. 85.6 kph. Hetmyer prods forward and pushes it to mid off.
Full and outside off. Hope drives it to wide long off for a single.
Over the wicket. Googly, on a length, on leg stump. Hetmyer hangs back and tucks it to square leg for a single.
Hetmyer is off the mark!!! Full and tossed up on the leg side. Eases it to long on for a single.

WICKET!!! Gets the edge this time and gets his man!!! Googly, on a length, on off stump. Haris hangs back and looks to cut but gets a faint outside edge and taken behind the stumps by Amir Jangoo. Mohammad Haris' debut in CPL lasted only 3 balls, he departs for 1.

WICKET!!! Gets the edge this time and gets his man!!! Googly, on a length, on off stump. Haris hangs back and looks to cut but gets a faint outside edge and taken behind the stumps by Amir Jangoo. Mohammad Haris' debut in CPL lasted only 3 balls, he departs for 1.
Full and tossed up, googly, outside off. Haris goes after it with a wild swing but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Good length on off stump. 93.5 kph. Hope punches it to deep point for a single.
Full and outside off. Haris drills it hard to long off for a single.

WICKET!!! Moqim strikes first ball and that is the end of Glenn Phillips!!! Over the wicket. Good length on off stump. 82.8 kph. Googly. Phillips didn't pick it from the hand. Gets down on a knee and tries to go across the line over mid wicket. Gets a top edge on the slog sweep and it goes high in the air towards deep mid wicket. A simple catch for Evin Lewis in the deep.

WICKET!!! Moqim strikes first ball and that is the end of Glenn Phillips!!! Over the wicket. Good length on off stump. 82.8 kph. Googly. Phillips didn't pick it from the hand. Gets down on a knee and tries to go across the line over mid wicket. Gets a top edge on the slog sweep and it goes high in the air towards deep mid wicket. A simple catch for Evin Lewis in the deep.
88.7 kph. Full and around off. Hope pushes it to short mid wicket.
Good length outside off. 86.5 kph. Phillips hangs back and cuts it to deep backward point for a single.
Full and outside off. 86 kph. Drives it to deep cover point for a single.
Full and on the off stump. 84.1 kph. Flicks it to deep mid wicket for a single.
Good length outside off. 87.3 kph. Hangs back and punches it to long on for a single.
Over the wicket. Full and outside off. 84.5 kph. Hope looks to drive it through the off side but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls into the leg side. They take two runs.
Full and sprays it on the pads. 138.5 kph. Phillips misses the flick on the inside edge and wears it on the front pad.
Good length outside the off stump. Phillips drives it to short extra cover.
147.1 kph. Good length, angling into the pads. Works it to the right of mid on for a single.
FOUR RUNS!!! Class from Hope!!! Good length outside the off stump, angling in. Hope makes room on the leg side and slaps it over extra cover for a cracking boundary.

Dropped by Sufyan!!! Good length outside off. Hope flat bats it over mid on. Sufyan Moqim jumps at the edge of the circle but only manages to get his fingertips on it. He chases it down the ground and keeps it down to two runs.
Over the wicket. Good length, outside off, angling in at 141.8 kph. Hope hangs back and defends it in the off side.
Good length on the stumps. 133.3 kph. Phillips taps it back to the bowler.
Full on the pads. 136.5 kph. Phillips flicks it to short mid wicket.
Back of a length outside off. Hope looks to punch but gets an inside edge that rolls to backward square leg for a single.
Hard length outside off, angling in. Hope hops and fends it to cover.

WICKET!!! Joshua James with immediate impact!!! Fabian Allen with a fine catch at mid on and the Falcons land the first punch!!! Hard length, outside off, angling in. Dindyal decides to take it on and tries to go over mid on. Doesn't get it from the middle of his bat and miscues it high in the air. Allen backtracks from mid on and takes a good tumbling catch.

WICKET!!! Joshua James with immediate impact!!! Fabian Allen with a fine catch at mid on and the Falcons land the first punch!!! Hard length, outside off, angling in. Dindyal decides to take it on and tries to go over mid on. Doesn't get it from the middle of his bat and miscues it high in the air. Allen backtracks from mid on and takes a good tumbling catch.
Over the wicket. Good length, angling in from off stump. Dindyal taps it back to the bowler.
Good length outside off. Dindyal gets forward and opens the bat face to nudge it to point for a run.

Nasty delivery from Alzarri!!! Back of a length, outside off, angling in. Dindyal gets behind the line but takes his eyes off the ball at the last second. The ball hits the shoulder of his bat and rolls in the off side. Alzarri gives him a stare.
WIDE!!! Length ball down the leg. Dindyal watches it go through to the keeper.

Appeal for LBW but the finger stays down!!! Good length, angling in from off stump. 141.8 kph. Dindyal is late on the flick and misses it on the inside edge. Wears it on the front pad. Loud shout for LBW but the umpire is umpire is unmoved. Alzarri and the keeper urges Moeen Ali to send it upstairs. Fair delivery on the front foot. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat. Ball tracking shows that it would have clipped the side of the leg stump. Review retained but Dindyal survives.
Good length, angling into the pads. Works it to square leg for a single.

FOUR RUNS!!! Sweet sound off the bat!!! 144.1 kph. Full and outside the off stump. Phillips presents the full face of the bat and drives it down the ground. Beats mid off to his right easily and the ball races away to the fence.
A slip in place!!! Over the wicket. Hard length outside off. 135.5 kph. GP whips it away to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Length ball outside off. 90 kph. Dindyal hangs back and cuts it hard but picks out the man at backward point. He punches his bat in frustration, feels like he missed out on a boundary ball.

Full and tossed up outside off. 87.5 kph. Drives it to the left of long off for a couple of runs. Springer with a throw at the bowler's end but Fabian Allen wasn't standing behind the stumps. The ball just misses the stumps. Phillips is safe.
Full and tossed up on the off stump. 90.2 kph. Gets forward and blocks it in the off side.
Fuller length on off stump. 89.2 kph. Defends it from the crease.
Length bal outside off. 88 kph. Spinning away from the right-hander. Phillips hangs back and cuts it to the right of point for a single.
FOUR RUNS!!! Muscled away by GP!!! Around the wicket. Full and on the stumps. Phillips bends his back knee and lofts it to the right of mid on from the inside half of his bat for a boundary.
Hard length on off stump. Opens the bat face and nudges it to backward point. Dindyal looks for a single but is sent back by GP.
Short of a length, outside off. Dindyal goes for the cut but misses it to the keeper.
Good length shaping away from outside off. Dindyal shoulders arms at it.
142.6 kph. Hard length on the pads. Dindyal tucks it away to deep fine leg. The man at deep backward square leg runs to his right and cuts it off.
Good length shaping away from outside off. Left alone to the keeper.
Over the wicket. Good length on off stump. 139.7 kph. GP taps it in front of extra cover with soft hands for a quick single.
Length ball outside off. Slaps it to point. A fumble from Lewis inside the circle allows the batters to get two runs. The southpaw overan it.
PEACH!!! Good length, around off stump. Spins away sharply. Dindyal looks to push at that but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR RUNS!!! First boundary of Qualifier 1!!!! Length ball, spinning away from outside off. Dindyal hangs back adn cuts it hard to deep point for a boundary.
88.7 kph. Full and outside off. Drives it to short extra cover.
GP and GAW are off the mark!!! Arm ball, on a length, outside off. 95.9 kph. Phillips punches it to the left of Allen and picks up a single.
Around the wicket. Full and on the stumps. Arm ball at 96.4 kph. GP pushes it to mid on.

Full and flighted on the off stump. Uses his feet and launches this off the leading edge over Shamar's head at extra cover, picks up the winning brace! A maiden final appearance is confirmed for the Falcons. They will meet the winner of Qualifier 2 between Guyana Amazon Warriors and Jamaica Kingsmen.
Around the wicket, 83.7 kph. Good length on the off stump. Defends off the backfoot.
Full and outside off. Driven straight to Veerasammy Permaul at cover point.
84.9 kph. Short and just outside off. Punched off the backfoot to extra cover.

FOUR RUNS! Jangoo is off the mark! 84.8 kph. Tossed up delivery outside off. Jangoo gets on the front foot and plays a delightful cover drive all along the floor. Pierces the gap through the infield to find the vacant boundary.
86.7 kph. Full and flighted googly outside off. Leans forward to drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.

IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! 94.7 kph. A full length quicker googly pitching on the middle stump line. Cornwall gets on the front foot and lofts it straight down the ground. Not enough distance on the hit. Easy catch for Hetmyer, 5 metres inside the long off boundary.

IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! 94.7 kph. A full length quicker googly pitching on the middle stump line. Cornwall gets on the front foot and lofts it straight down the ground. Not enough distance on the hit. Easy catch for Hetmyer, 5 metres inside the long off boundary.
Over the wicket. Slower through the air. Short of a length and away from the off stump. Cornwall reaches out for it, swings across and misses.

SIX MORE! Falcons are one hit away from victory! Short of a length outside the off stump. Pulls off the front foot. Picks up the length very early and swings into the leg side. Clears the backward square boundary and goes down on the ground with cramps!
FREE HIT AND FOUR RUNS! Full toss outside the off stump. Lewis clears the front leg and gives it a good hack. Launches over extra cover. One bounce and four!
Good length outside the off stump. Cuts it to Mehidy at cover. It's a no ball!
On a length and off stump. Pushed down to mid off.

FOUR RUNS! Squeezed through the off side once more. Goes for the yorker outside the off stump but misses. Lewis gets forward and opens the face of the bat. Perfectly times it and uses the pace to hit it square of the wicket. Finds the gap between cover point and backward point.

SIX RUNS! Lewis joins the party! On a length and wide of the off stump. Shamar tries to keep it away from Lewis's reach but he throws his hands at the ball from the front foot. Big slash, the ball flies off the outside half of the bat and clears the backward point boundary.
Around the wicket. Back of a length and away from the off stump, swing and a miss.
Full and just outside off. Cornwall on the front foot looks to clip in the leg side and misses. Shai Hope gets yorked and is hit on his shin. Cornwall returns to his crease in time.

SIX MORE! 17-ball 50 for the Falcons! 89.1 kph. Flatter on the leg stump line. Easy pickings for Cornwall again. Smashes this on the front foot. Good swing, finds the middle again and beats the jumping Hetmyer at the long off boundary.

SIX AGAIN! Raining boundaries in Barbados! 95 kph. Full length and following Cornwall on the leg stump. Leans forward and swings through the line. Good use of the hands, finds the middle of the bat and nothing. Clears the long off fence.
FOUR RUNS! Ballistic from Cornwall! 87.2 kph. Short and flat on the off stump. Swats it off the backfoot. A flat batted smash over mid on, one bounce and four.
FOUR MORE! This time over the off side. 94.9 kph. Full length and middle stump line. Clears the front leg, makes room in the on side and goes inside out over extra cover. One bounce and four!

SIX RUNS! Cornwall welcomes Pierre with a biggie! Around the wicket, 81.9 kph. Short delivery on the leg stump. Transfers his weight on the backoot and swings across the line. Finds the middle once more to clear deep midwicket.
Short on the off stump. Launched down the ground to the left of Hetmyer at long on for a single.

SIX RUNS! Cornwall is looking for an early finish. 84.3 kph. Over the wicket. Full on the leg stump line. Lunges forward and picks it up across the line. One handed swipe to clear the square leg boundary. 88 metres long hit. Cornwall has a huge smile on his face.
84.6 kph. Good length on the off stump. Played off the backfoot to long off.
84.4 kph. Full and outside off. Defends on the front foot to Shamar at point.
On a length and off stump. Punched to mid on.
Around the wicket. Good length on the off stump. Punched off the backfoot to mid on.
Short of a length outside off. Shuffles in the off side to swing across but wears it on the pads.

SIX MORE! Launched down the ground again. 89 kph. Full length on the middle stump line. Cornwall lunges forward and swings beautifully down the ground. Long on is placed straighter, runs across in the long off region only to watch it sail over. 73 mettres long hit.

SIX RUNS! Straight down the ground for a biggie! 86.7 kph. Full length ball pitching on the middle stump, a googly. Makes room, gets forward and smothers it high down the ground. Clears 85 metres over long on.
87.7 kph. Full and outside off. Goes for a big drive, inside edge on the pads.

FOUR RUNS! Easy as you like it! 94.8 kph. Full length on the middle stump. Cornwall  makes room, gets on the front foot and launches it up and over extra cover. Clears the infield and gets the boundary.
Over the wicket. 95.1 kph. Good length just outside off. Cuts off the backfoot. Backward point dives to his right and makes a half stop.
